status: design and asset handoff; host UI not implemented
safeArea: Apply the existing app safe-area rect before this layout; proof images omit OS bars.
sharedCanvas: Use existing CanvasScaler and convert reference units. Do not introduce a competing root canvas.

chat.avatar: reuse approved avatarId/frameId assets; sample symbols are fixture data
chat.heightFormula: paddingTop + name line + measured body line count * lineHeight + separate timestamp row + paddingBottom; never overlay timestamp with last body line
chat.longWords: wrap long tokens, URLs and unbroken CJK strings if introduced; do not scale the whole bubble
chat.emoji: use existing supported emoji/fallback system; never assume the rounded text font covers emoji
chat.compactTeamName: Fit 44 to42 reference units, then ellipsize for display only; full unchanged server name in details

requestCard.recipientCTA: Collect only after authoritative claimable amount exists

tabs.mail: route to existing team mailbox; its redesign is not included in this milestone
tabs.teamInfo: existing R4 Team Details member page
tabs.unread: server-provided count; hide zero; use 99+ cap only if localization supports it

navigation: Reuse R4/Home dock and selection assets. Selection appears on click/tap and remains selected; no hover-only variant.

input.composer: anchored above keyboard/safe-area; preserve draft while navigating or reconnecting
input.navigationWhileKeyboardOpen: hide dock and two-button action row
input.keyboardReturn: respect multiline policy; no accidental submission

responsive.phone: fill safe width; fixed header/actions, scrollable feed; no font shrinking for dense content
responsive.shortScreens: allow compact summary or scrollable summary; preserve input and action touch size
responsive.tablet: center a capped content column; sample proof uses 520 dp on a 768 dp canvas
responsive.keyboard: 09_Composer_Keyboard_Viewport_RU is only the game viewport above the OS keyboard; keyboard art is not included
responsive.textScaling: remeasure body and controls when accessibility text scale changes; scroll instead of truncating

touchTargets.hitRect: expand to at least 144 reference units without covering neighboring controls

sampling: Preview uses alpha-aware minification at each output size; renderer is not a Unity GPU implementation.

nineSlice.source: SocialComponentManifest and TeamsAccess_ComponentManifest; do not use whole-image stretching

runtimeValidation: pending: Unity import, Android captures, font/text scaling, safe area, keyboard, scroll and backend
